$comment: EFB-54 boundary discipline. Routes whose request bodies do NOT yet go through parseRouteBody (see docs/BOUNDARY_DISCIPLINE.md). This list is a RATCHET, not an amnesty: it may only shrink. Every entry carries a sunset date, and scripts/check-boundary-discipline.mjs FAILS the build once that date passes rather than warning, so extending a deadline is a visible decision in code review instead of a silent one. Sunsets more than 180 days out are rejected outright: a ratchet whose end can be pushed arbitrarily forward is an amnesty wearing a ratchet's clothes. New routes may not be added here - write them against parseRouteBody. The noBody list is separate: those routes read no request body at all, and they are DECLARED rather than detected because body reads hide behind helpers the checker cannot follow, and a checker that infers safety from silence is the bug this ticket exists to close.

unmigrated.$comment: PERMANENT EXEMPTION — raw-body-required-for-HMAC-verification / do-not-migrate. GitHub signs the exact bytes it sent (X-Hub-Signature-256), so this route must read the body as text and verify before parsing. Routing it through parseRouteBody would either verify a re-serialized body (silently wrong for any payload whose JSON round-trip is not byte-identical) or verify nothing. EFB-61 left it deliberately. The sunset date is retained only because the checker requires one; do not treat it as an intent to migrate.
